inspection_summary: Inspected all 669 lines. The paper turns Polya's Jensen-polynomial reformulation of RH into an asymptotic program: a general finite-difference theorem makes normalized Jensen polynomials converge to Hermite polynomials, an all-orders saddle-point expansion verifies the hypotheses for central zeta derivatives, and effective computation establishes every shift in degrees at most eight. Modular-form and partition examples show the mechanism is sequence-general rather than zeta-specific.
